messages:
sanjay (oncall): paging oncall — major p99 spike on streaming API starting ~1765003180. Alerts showing streaming stalls and increased tail latency across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Customers reporting partial streaming timeouts.

incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: service=streaming-api severity=P1 triggered at 1765003200. Target: oncall-sre. Escalation started.

maria (sre): seeing p95 ~450ms -> 900ms and p99 up to 6s on the realtime route. Request traces show long wait at "cache-lookup" and then falling back to cold path.

kevin (eng-runtime): interesting — recent prefix-caching change merged yesterday altered prefix hash salt for model variants. Could be cache miss storm. Looking at cache hit rates now.

maria (sre): cache hit-rate for prefix-cache for model-gpt-medium: 0.7% last 30m (normally ~42%). KV-cache metrics show massive cold loads.

kevin (eng-runtime): confirmed. Metrics from redis-cluster-3: incr miss_rate at 1765003000..1765003600. Hashing function changed in commit 7f5c2d (PR #4126). That rollout was targeted but we rolled to 40% traffic at 22:30 UTC.

sanjay (oncall): customer impact: chat streaming stalls and visible stalls in partial responses; some clients hit client-side 5s timeouts. CS flagged 3 high-tier customers experiencing degraded UX. @emily (cs) can you confirm business impact?

emily (cs): yep — Customer A and Customer B reported interruptions in streaming sessions starting ~12:02. They're seeing repeated reconnects. Logged priority tickets and asked for regular updates.

maria (sre): immediate mit: revert prefix-hash variant to previous behavior (rollback PR #4126) and pin routing to old cache key for affected model group. I can trigger a rollback if ops approves.

kevin (eng-runtime): to be safe, we should also enable fallback throttle to reduce cold-cache storming — limit concurrent cold inits to 50/s and enable gradual ramp. I'll open an emergency config override.

deploy-bot: Revert deployment requested by maria. Deployment queued: revert-pr-4126 -> rolling restart of 6 runtime pods in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. ETA ~3m per region.

maria (sre): applying temporary iptables rule to route traffic to dedicated warm pool for streaming (no cold init) for 10 minutes while rollback propagates. Running command: 

```
# route affected prefix -> warm-pool
routedump apply --service streaming-api --selector prefix=affected --pool warm-pool --ttl 600
```

kevin (eng-runtime): also pushing a hotfix to computation of prefix hash to preserve compatibility: `hotfix/prefix-compat` — but we'll prefer rollback first. Hotfix will be staged after rollback if needed.

maria (sre): rollback confirmed deploying. Watching cache hit-rate and p99.

(2 minutes pass)

maria (sre): rollback completed in eu-west-1. Cache hit-rate back to 38% in 60s, p95 dropped to 210ms, p99 down to ~900ms. us-west-2 still rolling.

kevin (eng-runtime): verifying logs for signature of bad hash: here's sample from runtime logs when cache miss happens: 

```
[1765003262] INFO prefix_lookup model=gpt-medium prefix_id=abcd1234 computed_hash=0x9f1a mismatch_prev=0x2b7c -> cache MISS
[1765003262] INFO fallback cold_init model=gpt-medium session_id=xyz pid=4523 init_ms=542
```

maria (sre): confirming: misses were due to changed computed_hash not matching stored keys. Revert fixed key calculation.

emily (cs): I updated Customer A ticket: "Engineering rolled back a change affecting prefix hashing which should restore streaming stability; monitoring shows improvements in eu-west-1. We'll keep you updated as we confirm full global recovery." Customer responded :thumbsup:.

sanjay (oncall): handoff notes for next oncall (tomorrow): root cause = prefix-hash salt change from PR #4126 caused cache namespace mismatch and mass cold-cache fallbacks, leading to p99 spikes and streaming stalls. Immediate mitigation = rollback PR #4126, route affected prefixes to warm pool, enable cold-init throttle, and monitor cache hit-rate >30% and p99 < 1s for 30m before closing.

kevin (eng-runtime): follow-ups: 1) add compatibility test to catch prefix-hash changes in canary stage, 2) improve deployment gating to prevent 40% rollout without observed cache hit parity, 3) create a runbook for prefix-cache regressions. I'll open issues and assign.

maria (sre): monitoring note: set alert threshold to trigger earlier on sustained miss_rate > 10% for 5m to avoid reaching SLO breach.

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved? provisional at 1765003725. Please confirm.

maria (sre): marking as mitigated. We'll keep incident open for postmortem. Last seen p99 ~700ms and hit-rate stable at 41% for 12m.

emily (cs): CS update sent to affected customers summarizing mitigation and ETA for postmortem (24h).

sanjay (oncall): leaving detailed handoff: timeline, commands used, affected model groups (gpt-medium, gpt-small), PR numbers (4126 rollback, 4130 hotfix), runbook pointers. Please pick up postmortem. I'll add logs and traces to the incident doc. Thanks everyone.

kevin (eng-runtime): assigning myself to postmortem and tests.

maria (sre): adding final note: if you see residual stalls, don't restart runtime pods in bulk — that can reintroduce cold storm. Use gradual rolling restart with warm-pool priming.

sanjay (oncall): handing off oncall to alice (tomorrow) — details in /oncall/handoffs. End of thread.
